description.value: Barcelona Tapas & Wine Bar is a Spanish tapas restaurant tucked into the renovated historical Bow Mart building in Snug Cove on Bowen Island. The menu draws on locally sourced ingredients, sustainable seafood, and hormone- and antibiotic-free meats alongside specialty imported Spanish products. It is a dinner-only destination, making it a worthy stop for cyclists arriving on the Bowen Island ferry looking for an evening meal.
